g.text: 1 Power: bike connectors J101 and J102, harness fuse, reverse polarity, TVS, LC filter, 5 V buck, Pico hold-up

g.desc: 2 Warning lights: neutral, high beam, turn signals and illumination through EL817 optocouplers

g.text: 3 Tachometer: coil negative to the H11L1 Schmitt trigger

g.text: 4 Wheel sensor: LJ12A3 inductive sensor on J401, through an EL817

g.desc: 4 Wheel sensor: LJ12A3 inductive sensor on J401, through an EL817

g.text: 5 Analog inputs: battery voltage, coolant sender and ambient light to the ADC

g.text: 6 MCU: Raspberry Pi Pico, FRAM for the odometer, MODE and SET buttons

g.text: 7 Backlight and Pi: TPS61169 backlight driver dimmed by the Pico, USB link to the Pi

g.text: 8 Backup LEDs: indicators wired straight to the bike, alive with the electronics off
